name: smwgraphics-terranigma-underworld-tower-exterior
title: Terranigma - Underworld Tower (Exterior)
description:
The mysterious and otherwordly crystals seen in the exterior side of the Underworld Towers, from Terranigma. This version includes an asm made by Donut which replicates the dark gradient applied in the background of the original game. It should be inserted using the UberASM Tool.

A good fit for crystal caves or otherwordly levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
